subject: Tekton 2-pc split beam torque set $216.75 vs. one Mac wrench $459.99
summary: Tekton's 3/8" + 1/2" split beam torque wrench set is $216.75 on Tekton's outlet, while Mac Tools lists one split beam wrench at $459.99.
body: Today's pick: Tekton's 3/8" + 1/2" drive flex-head split beam torque wrench set (TRQ99903, 2 wrenches) is $216.75 on Tekton's outlet, down from $255. It's a discontinued model, so when it's gone, it's gone. Mac Tools lists its TWV250P split beam torque wrench, one wrench, at $459.99. That's two wrenches for $243 less than one off the truck. Check the torque ranges against the work you do before you buy.
Also worth a look: the Hazet 2152-600 multimeter is $179.62 at KC Tool. Mac's EM730 Pro digital multimeter is $299.99. Different meters, so compare the features you actually use.
Every deal we track is at offthetruckhq.com.
